businesses.business: engineering, specialty health care and IT staffing and consulting services

offering_description.value: Provides specialty health care staffing (mainly school-based therapy and nursing), engineering and technical consulting, and IT and specialty staffing services. Sells to schools, utilities, industrial companies, and corporate clients, delivering through its own professionals and consultants.

primary_services.value: specialty health care staffing; engineering consulting and design; IT consulting and staffing; project management and compliance services

customer_segment.value: B2B: utilities, industrial and manufacturing firms, life sciences and commercial clients, hospitals; B2G: public school districts and government-related entities

end_markets.value: education; healthcare; utilities and energy; life sciences; industrial and manufacturing

revenue_model.value: service fees: hourly billing for placed clinicians, engineers and IT professionals; project or contract: fixed-price and time-and-materials engineering and IT projects

value_chain_position.value: service provider: employs and places clinicians, engineers and IT consultants for schools, utilities and corporate clients

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada, with some operations in Puerto Rico and Serbia

specialization.value: related lines: health care staffing, engineering services and IT staffing, all professional staffing and consulting

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house business development and recruiters selling to school districts and corporate clients

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: employment and staffing laws, healthcare professional licensing, school contracting rules, and nuclear and utility engineering standards
